phase_name: bug-fix — Vercel CI + local dev server

completed_tasks.name: Fixed local dev 500: removed --turbopack from dev script (Sentry 10.49.0 crashes in Next.js 15.5.15 Turbopack edge runtime)
Added terser as devDependency (minify-sanity.mjs postinstall failed with 'command not found' on Vercel)
Pinned TypeScript back to ^5 (pnpm add terser unlocked TS 5.9.3→6.0.3; TS6 breaks CSS side-effect imports under moduleResolution:bundler)
Added Sanity env vars to Vercel (Production + Preview) via Vercel UI — previous CLI attempts stored corrupt base64 values

remaining_tasks.name: Fix Vercel pnpm install --frozen-lockfile failure (exits 1 — likely Node version mismatch: local v24 vs Vercel v22, or lockfile regenerated with wrong Node)
Clear browser cookies (x-market) and test HK/SG navigation buttons
Verify design consistency once Sanity data loads on Vercel
Decide next milestone: Phase 08 (Analytics/GBP), Phase 09 (Security), or Phase 10 (DNS cutover)

blockers.description: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile exits with 1 on Vercel. Full error not visible via CLI — only exit code shown. Root cause likely: lockfile regenerated locally with Node v24 but Vercel uses Node 22.
blockers.workaround: Check full build log in Vercel UI. Likely fix: add .node-version file with '22', or run pnpm install on Node 22 to regenerate lockfile, or broaden engines.node range.

human_actions_pending.action: Check Vercel build logs for exact pnpm install error (vercel.com/scr1/proavtive-c325 → latest deployment → Build Logs)
human_actions_pending.context: CLI shows only exit code 1. Full log in Vercel UI shows which package fails.

decisions.decision: Removed --turbopack from dev script only (kept in build script)
decisions.rationale: Sentry 10.49.0 crashes in Next.js 15.5.15 Turbopack edge runtime. Webpack dev works fine.
minify-sanity.mjs postinstall runs npx terser which fails on Vercel without terser in node_modules.
^6 range pulled in TS 6.0.3 which breaks CSS side-effect imports under moduleResolution:bundler.

decisions.decision: Never use Vercel CLI to set env vars — use Vercel UI or REST API with type:plain
decisions.rationale: CLI stored corrupt base64-encoded blobs for env var values instead of plain strings.

next_action: Check Vercel UI build logs for exact pnpm install error. Most likely fix: add .node-version file pinned to 22 or regenerate lockfile on Node 22.
context_notes: Local dev server works at http://localhost:3000 (webpack). Three fixes pushed (e401e8d, e6f3af3). Sanity env vars correctly set in Vercel UI for Production + Preview. Only remaining blocker is pnpm install on Vercel. Dependabot PRs are noise — security update PRs on GitHub, do not merge.
